pages.title: Echo of the End
pages.text: Chorus Flower · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Chorus Flower Tea Bag in a teapot with water; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)The gods gave death to mankind, and kept life for themselves.$(br2)— Epic of Gilgamesh

pages.title: Effect
pages.text: A killing blow is answered: blink away alive on one heart, deathless and fireproof for 12s.$(br2)$(br2)Echo 5:00
